name: repo_map
description: Project code map: files ↔ symbols. For 100+ file codebases. focused+relevantEntities for token efficiency.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: project root (abs). reindex first if new.

focused.description: Limit output ~2000 tokens. Combine with relevantEntities.

relevantFiles.description: Only include these files (rel to root)

relevantEntities.description: Only include files that contain these top-level symbols (e.g. ["spawnFixer", "agentLoop"])
